name: Tanuki
body:
Tanuki are a species of shapeshifters who dwell on the fringe of civilization, near the border of wild, untamed lands.

Appearance

Tanuki look very much like humanoid raccoon dogs. Their fur is brown, gray, or red, with lighter fur on their muzzles and dark circles around the eyes. They are squat and stout and tend to have big, round bellies.

Social

Tanuki are almost unshakably jovial and move with a comical, bouncy gait that can bring a smile to the faces of those around them. However, their sense of humor can sometimes go too far, frustrating friends and enemies alike.

Inveterate tricksters, tanuki love deceiving humans above all and will go out their way to prank their favorite targets. They also get along well with fey and gnomes, whom they see as kindred souls. However, they dislike kitsune (with whom they are sometimes mistaken), having a long-standing and sometimes contentious rivals with these fellow shapechangers.

All tanuki share a deep love of-and weakness for-alcohol. A tanuki can often be enticed to help a stranger in exchange for alcohol, but they become increasingly erratic the more they drink.

Magic looms large in tanuki society. All tanuki are born with spell-like abilities, and many develop into much more skilled magic users.

Alignment and Religion

Tanuki are usually Chaotic Neutral in alignment. They are free spirits beholden to only their own desires. Many are good natured in their mischief-making, but their attitude can turn on a whim. They especially dislike bullies and braggarts, and can become cruel or vindictive against anyone they perceive as an enemy-warranted or not.

Many tanuki practice faiths rooted in nature, fey, or the spirit world. As a species, they are very protective of nature, regardless of their religious practices. Some will defend it with mere pranks, while others become extremely aggressive towards those who would define its splendor.

Names

Some typical tanuki names include the following (choose or roll 1d12): 1 Aniri, 2 Ashidora, 3 Daikana, 4 Damasoko, 5 Hoto, 6 Ichiyoki, 7 Mawano, 8 Mukai, 9 Nekkano, 10 Shubito, 11 Sishimaso, 12 Watakona

Common Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You are sturdy and confident. Your ability score modifiers are +2 Con, +2 Cha [flexible]. (2)
Size As a Medium creature, you have no bonuses or penalties due to size. (0)
Type You are a Monstrous Humanoid with the shapechanger subtype. (3)
Speed Your base speed is 30 feet. (0)
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Tanuki. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Celestial, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, Sylvan, and Tengu. (0)
Other Traits
Change Shape (Su) You can change your shape at will to assume the form of a Tiny animal-usually a raccoon or raccoon dog, but sometimes a badger, squirrel, rat, cat, potbellied pig, or other Tiny animal form. Changing into this form works as beast shape II, except that you always take the form of the same, specific animal and can maintain this form indefinitely. Regardless of the exact appearance you have chosen, you always use the base abilities listed for a raccoon. While in your animal form, you are effectively disguised as an animal; you gain a +10 species bonus on Disguise checks to appear as this animal while in this form, and take no penalties on your Disguise check for being a creature of a different type. (5)
Darkvision You have darkvision 60 feet. (-)
Low-Light Vision You can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. You retain the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions. (1)
Sake Affinity (Su) As a standard action, you can take a swig of alcohol. (Most tanuki always carry a gourd of sake at their side for just such a purpose.) A number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1), when you do so, you gain the effects of an expeditious retreat spell for 1 minute. However, each time you take a swig of alcohol (for any reason), you also become progressively drunker and take a -1 penalty to your AC and on Reflex saves for 1 minute. These penalties stack. (2)
Tanuki Magic You can use detect poison, magic stone, and purify food and drink once per day each as spell-like abilities. Your character level is your caster level, and Charisma is your casting ability. (2)
Total: 15 RP (advanced)
Alternate Traits
Tool Shape (Su) Choose one type of tool, houseware, or similar item of Tiny or Small size. You can transform into your chosen form, with results similar to tree shape. In this form, you appear as an ordinary item of your chosen type. Your appearance is always the same each time you assume this form. You can assume your tool shape or revert to your true form as a ? swift action. This trait replaces change shape.
Favored Class Bonuses
Arcanist Increase the maximum number of points in your arcane reservoir by +1.
Barbarian Add a +1/2 bonus to your trap sense.
Bard Add +1 to your total number of bardic performance rounds per day.
Bloodrager Add +1/4 to the number of uses per day of expeditious retreat gained from your sake affinity species trait.
Druid Select one domain power granted at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier. Add +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that domain power.
Fighter Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a dirty trick or trip attempt.
Friar Add +1 to your total number of evangelization rounds per day.
Magus Add +1/4 to the number of uses per day of expeditious retreat gained from your sake affinity species trait.
Mesmerist Increase the number of mesmerist tricks you can use per day by +1/3.
Monk Add +1/4 to the number of uses per day of expeditious retreat gained from your sake affinity species trait.
Oracle Add +1/2 to your effective oracle level for the purpose of determining the effects of your curse ability.
Psychic Increase the total number of points in your phrenic pool by +1/3 point.
Ranger Add +1/6 of the Extra Ranger Trap feat or +1/6 of the Learn Ranger Trap feat. You must meet all of the prerequisites for whatever feat you gain.
Rogue Add a +1/2 bonus on Disguise checks and a +1/2 bonus on Use Magic Device checks to emulate a species.
Shifter Add +1/4 to the number of minutes you can assume your minor form each day.
Sorcerer Add +1/4 to the number of uses per day of expeditious retreat gained from your sake affinity species trait.
Wizard Select one arcane school power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier. Add +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that arcane school power.
